text: {"assertions":["A race condition in platform/config/loader.py occurs when two requests compete for the same key.","The root cause of the bug was clock skew between two hosts, causing incorrect environment selection in the config loader.","The bug manifests as a production endpoint appearing in a staging process.","The fix involved replacing the deadline with a monotonic clock, implemented in PR #2101 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1.","The bug can be reproduced by booting the service with an unset profile variable.","The test case covering this bug is located in tests/platform/test_config_loader.py.","After the fix, job execution time improved from 6 hours to 60 minutes."]}
